pages.text: Spirit Form is unlocked in the skill tree (key $(thing)H$()) at 1 level of experience.$(br2)You can enable or disable the form with the $(thing)G$() key. While in the form, you fly, pass through blocks, take no damage, and see in the dark.

The form consumes hunger based on the distance traveled. When hunger reaches zero, the form turns off.$(br2)After exiting the form inside a mob, there is a cooldown for the form (its duration is in the config).
